g.text: 2. Tuna stops; the helper and Pi carry on
4. Tuna starts, reads its saved list of chats, reconnects
5. finished messages, then the unfinished reply so far, then live events
6. the chat looks exactly as before and keeps streaming
7. later: no Tuna attached and Pi idle for a minute, so the helper stops Pi and exits
8. after a reboot or an idle exit: a new helper starts Pi on the same session file
